scope: Read-only one-photo diagnostic of the existing automatically estimated red/white palette model. No mask, crop, fit weights or solver changed; no new model trained.

metadata.model: Nonnegative sRGB paper mixture with scalar illumination

calibrationQualification: Manual paper-patch calibration, not an automatic result; white/red patch errors are in-sample. Gold patch is used only for diagnosis.
relativeResidualDefinition: NNLS RGB reconstruction residual divided by RGB vector norm, with a 0.05 denominator floor; empirical sRGB coordinates.
sampleQualification: Three sparse rectangles selected by visible RGB appearance before computing scores; not dense visibility labels or held-out detector evaluation.
limitations: No threshold selected and no pixels excluded from fitting.
Some third-colour objects can lie within the two-paper mixture model; low residual does not prove visible paper.
Legitimate paper under changing colour illumination can also have high residual.
This probe cannot establish automatic ribbon segmentation or generalize to other photographs.

visualReview.finding: Automatic residual responds to substantial white-paper regions as well as the ribbon. Manual calibration makes the ribbon more distinct but leaves large residuals on other illuminated or mixed boundaries. No automatic visibility mask is accepted.

findings: Automatic relative-residual medians are 0.05782 for the sampled white paper and 0.05814 for the sampled gold: this pair is not usefully separated by a simple threshold.
Manual paper-patch calibration changes these medians to 0.00549 and 0.08190. This demonstrates palette sensitivity, not held-out detection accuracy; the white patch participates in calibration.
The original fixed mask, crop, observation weights and all reconstruction scores remain untouched.
